generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Launch: 98 kWh (Standard Range) and 131 kWh (Extended Range) usable packs; DC rated 155 kW officially. Last year 2025, ended December 2025. No model-year pack or DC change found. The planned successor is a range-extended truck (gas generator), outside a BEV catalogue. Canada sold the same truck; no CA-specific end date was found. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ford_F-150_Lightning ; https://insideevs.com/news/781883/ford-f-150-lightning-dead/
